subject: ready-for-life
title: Planning Systems and Time Management
essential_question: What planning system does this learner actually keep using when a week gets hard?
topics: choosing a calendar and task system that fits
capturing commitments before they are forgotten
breaking a multi-week obligation into steps
estimating how long a task really takes
protecting sleep, study, and recovery time
reviewing a week and adjusting the system
performance_task: Run a personal planning system for two weeks, then report what it caught, what it missed, and one change made.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Household Independence and Home Systems
essential_question: Which household systems can this learner keep running without being reminded?
topics: laundry, cleaning, and supply rotation as a system
safe use of household appliances with supervision
recognising a repair that needs a qualified adult
routine upkeep and seasonal tasks
storing and labelling supplies safely
handing a task back with a clear status
performance_task: Take documented ownership of two recurring household systems for two weeks with adult review.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Food Systems: Planning, Shopping, and Cooking
essential_question: How does a person get a week of decent meals planned, bought, and cooked safely?
topics: planning meals across a week
building a shopping list from a plan
food safety, storage, and expiry
knife and heat safety under supervision
cooking three balanced meals
reducing waste and using leftovers
performance_task: Plan, shop for, and prepare three balanced meals across a week with adult supervision for heat and knives.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Transportation and Trip Planning
essential_question: How does a person get somewhere unfamiliar, on time, with a backup plan?
topics: reading schedules, maps, and routes
planning a trip backwards from an arrival time
comparing travel options on time, cost, and reliability
what to do when a connection fails
personal safety and check-in agreements
local rules for travel and identification
performance_task: Plan a complete round trip to an unfamiliar destination including timing, cost, contingency, and a check-in plan, and complete it with the agreed supervision.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Communication and Self-Advocacy
essential_question: How does this learner ask for what they need, clearly and without apology?
topics: stating a need clearly and specifically
asking a question of an unfamiliar adult
making and confirming an appointment
writing a short, clear message that gets a response
listening, confirming, and taking notes
following up when there is no reply
performance_task: Prepare and carry out one real request or appointment conversation with adult support, then evaluate how it went.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Grade 9 Independence Capstone
essential_question: Can this learner run their own week — plan, home, food, travel, and communication — and show it?
topics: integrating the year's systems into one week
documenting evidence without oversharing
adult attestation of real-world tasks
identifying what still needs support
planning the next step honestly
presenting the week and defending the choices
performance_task: Run a documented one-week independence plan covering planning, a household system, meals, one trip, and one communication task, with adult attestation and a written review.
